NCERT revises textbooks, sparking debate on historical narratives

The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has revised content in Class 8 textbooks, leading to discussions about historical interpretations. Changes include alterations to chapters on the judiciary, India's freedom struggle, and the Partition. These revisions have prompted debate regarding the presentation of historical events and institutions in educational materials.
